column1: # A room's controls: what each does, its icon, and the row of
# `data/text.tsv` that names it, which is shown by it while the pointer
# is over it. A row whose name ends in `.on` is the same control once
# it is so; a row taken out is a control not drawn.
# On a message, at the end of its first line: answer it, like it, pin
# At the stream's foot: say what was written; answer nobody after all.
# In the room's title: search it, and list what is pinned in it; and
# begin a call there, without the camera and with it.
# Beside the room, on a person: back to who is here; write to them;
# Among friends, at the end of a person's line: part from them, or
# take back or turn down a request; accept one; ask.
# In the bag, at the end of a line: take the thing out.
# At the head of the account: put it away.
# At the stream's foot, before sending: post a picture from this disk.
# On a person: mute them, and unmute.
# In the account: sign in with what was typed.
# At the foot of the guide while the person is in a voice room: the
# room itself; the microphone; the sound of the others; the way out.
# A call's own controls, each with its icon, all one height, each on a
# ground of its own in the group's: the voice, the camera, the screen,
# The title's search field: it opens the Search window.
